templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for a mutual NDA allowing each party to share confidential information for a stated purpose while protecting it from unauthorized use and disclosure.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
templates.description: Cover Page for the Mutual NDA capturing the deal-specific terms (purpose, effective date, term, governing law, jurisdiction, parties and signatures) that incorporate the Mutual NDA Standard Terms.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software (SaaS), covering access and use, restrictions, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability and termination.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Supplement to a Cloud Service Agreement defining uptime targets, response times for support requests and the service credits owed when commitments are missed.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Agreement governing a provider's processing of customer personal data, covering processor/subprocessor roles, security, international transfers and GDPR/CCPA compliance.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement giving an early-stage partner access to a product in development in exchange for feedback and participation in a design partner program.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services and deliverables under statements of work (SOWs).

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for business partnerships between companies, covering each party's obligations, payments, trademark use, confidentiality and liability.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement governing how a provider may use, disclose and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing software that the customer installs and runs on its own systems, covering license scope, restrictions, fees, support and warranties.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for a limited-time trial or pilot of a product so a customer can evaluate it before committing to a full purchase.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum to a commercial agreement governing AI services, including rights in inputs and outputs, restrictions on model training and responsibilities for AI-generated content.
